Sample.evidence_source: A sample of 10 young men who died by suicide was studied by analyzing in depth-interviews of four to eight key informants related to each suicide, as well as six suicide notes.

Population.evidence_source: A sample of 10 young men who died by suicide was studied by analyzing in depth-interviews of four to eight key informants related to each suicide, as well as six suicide notes.

Type.evidence_source: The suicides of these 10 young men were selected from a total of 20 suicides from the PA study, among individuals with no prior psychiatric treatment and no previous suicide attempts.

Area.evidence_source: As self-esteem issues became more and more salient in the construction of the case narratives of the young men due to a problematic doubleness in their self in the transition to adulthood, the choice of sample was governed by a wish for a deeper exploration of the role of self-esteem in these suicides.
